# Mixtunes

> Mixtunes is a free, independent browser extension that applies a classic desktop music-library theme (sidebar, track list, Cover Flow) to streaming music sites. It does not stream audio itself; the host site remains the player. Available on YouTube Music today; Spotify, Apple Music, and SoundCloud are planned. Preferences stay on the device. Not affiliated with Apple, Google, Spotify, or SoundCloud.

## Product

- Homepage: https://ankush.one/mixtunes/
- Source: https://github.com/ankushKun/mixtunes
- Releases / manual install: https://github.com/ankushKun/mixtunes/releases
- Privacy: https://ankush.one/mixtunes/privacy.html
- Terms: https://ankush.one/mixtunes/terms.html

## What it does

- Themes supported streaming music websites in Chrome 121+ and Firefox 121+ (and Chromium-based browsers via the Chrome Web Store build once listed)
- Currently runs on music.youtube.com; more hosts are planned
- Shows library sources in a sidebar, songs in a sortable list, and album art in Cover Flow or grid
- Passes play, pause, skip, and seek through to the host player
- Themes: Metal, Graphite, or match the system appearance
- Can be turned off to restore the original site UI

## What it does not do

- No Mixtunes account; never asks for a password
- Does not unlock Premium, remove ads, or change what the account can play
- Does not work on phones, tablets, or Safari (yet)
- Does not send library or account data to the Mixtunes developer
- The browser extension includes no analytics SDK; the marketing site may use PostHog (see Privacy)
- Not an Apple, Google, Spotify, or SoundCloud product

## Install

1. Prefer the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons listing when available (homepage CTAs say In review until those listings ship). Until then, install from a GitHub release zip (manual / load unpacked).
2. Or download a release zip from GitHub and load it unpacked (Chrome-family) or as a temporary add-on (Firefox). Steps: https://ankush.one/mixtunes/#install
3. Open a supported player site while signed in (YouTube Music today: https://music.youtube.com).
